name: trama
description: See your System as a layered Model of state machines, review Proposals and Drifts, and steer your coding agent from one editor tab.

commands.title: Send to agent (closing the tab sends it too)

enumDescriptions: The editor's chat: Copilot in VS Code, Cursor in Cursor.
omp in the editor's integrated terminal.
Claude Code in the editor's integrated terminal.
trama.agent.markdownDescription: Agent used for every project and instruction: `chat` (the editor's chat: Copilot in VS Code, Cursor in Cursor; the default), `omp` (omp in the editor's integrated terminal) or `claude` (Claude Code in the editor's integrated terminal). It applies only in your user settings.

enumDescriptions: A terminal tab beside the active editor.
trama.terminalLocation.markdownDescription: Where `omp` and Claude Code terminals open: `editor` (a terminal tab beside the active editor; the default) or `panel` (the terminal area). It applies only in your user settings.

trama.autoFixDrifts.markdownDescription: When on, the agent recommends, approves and fixes non-critical Drifts on its own; off (the default) you decide on every Drift. It applies only in your user settings. After opening the editor, a finished scan or an explicit Resolve Drifts request is required before automatic collection resumes. A Task whose origin Drift is being fixed runs only after its fix Tasks are Done. A scan that failed or was interrupted counts as finished and does not suspend the delegation. Repeated automatic cycles have no additional limit. Turning it off stops new automatic steps but does not interrupt a Task already started, and it also turns off Auto Fix Critical Drifts.

trama.autoFixCriticalDrifts.markdownDescription: Also critical Drifts, the ones where your decision is urgently needed. It only applies while Auto Fix Drifts is on (default off). It applies only in your user settings.

trama.submitWhileRunning.markdownDescription: Let a run start while another run started by Trama is in progress. Off (the default): Run and Run all To do are unavailable while a run started by Trama is in progress. On: a run can start while another one is in progress.

trama.analysis.markdownDescription: Model for design work: quick and written design requests, Resolve Drifts and import. Write the name as your agent accepts it: omp, Claude Code or Cursor's chat; for Copilot's chat, the name shown in the chat's model picker. Empty (the default) leaves the agent's default model. In Copilot the model also stays in the chat's picker. It only applies in your user settings.

trama.scan.markdownDescription: Model for scans: of the System, of Features, and for the sub-agents that compare Machines, including those of the pre-flight check at the start of each Run. Write the name as your agent accepts it: omp, Claude Code or Cursor's chat; for Copilot's chat, the name shown in the chat's model picker. Empty (the default) leaves the agent's default model. In Copilot the model also stays in the chat's picker. The chats' sub-agents get it with Update skills. It only applies in your user settings.

trama.execution.markdownDescription: Model for implementing Tasks: implement and implement all, including the selective final scan of the run. Write the name as your agent accepts it: omp, Claude Code or Cursor's chat; for Copilot's chat, the name shown in the chat's model picker. Empty (the default) leaves the agent's default model. In Copilot the model also stays in the chat's picker. It only applies in your user settings.

trama.autoExit.markdownDescription: Close the agent's terminal as soon as the agent is idle or its command ends (default on). With it off, idle terminals stay open and every instruction still opens a new one. It only applies in your user settings.

trama.maxParallelAgents.markdownDescription: How many sub-agents the agent may run at once, in a scan, in the exploration of a design and in a run of Tasks (default 20; agents without sub-agents ignore it).

trama.skillsDir.markdownDescription: Folder, relative to the project root, where Get Started and **Trama: Update Agent Skills** install the agent skills. Use `.claude/skills` for Claude Code.

trama.language.markdownDescription: Language the agent writes in, for example `Italian` or `Deutsch`. Trama fills it in on first start with your system language (or the editor's, otherwise `English`); you can change it or empty it. When set, every instruction Trama sends to the agent asks it to write everything it generates in that language, except code, which always stays in English. Empty asks nothing about language. It only reaches agents that Trama starts, changes nothing already written, and the Trama interface stays in English.
